'''Electric Nexus''' is a [[Facilities|facility]] [[item]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|The very first Endfield Industries Electric Nexus was placed in the Northern Barrens. It had stood on that uninhabited permafrost for nearly a century.}}
==Usage==
Electric Nexuses are usually placed at the end of power transmission lines. Connect them to the power grid to supply power to nearby facilities.
==Acquisition==
Production: Requires Specified Basic AIC Plan Tech
